BACHELOR OF COMPUTER SCIENCE (COMPUTER SYSTEM AND NETWORK)


Programme Overview

The purpose of this programme is to produce graduates who understand and able to apply the knowledge in networking and the theory of computer systems. 


The graduates will have the ability to apply critical thinking skills and advanced scientific techniques in solving computer-based problems in line with the rapidly changing computer systems and technology.



Duration:  3.5 Years (7 Semester and 1 special semester), Full time (Coursework)

Career Prospects

Cybersecurity Analyst, Data Center Technician, Digital Forensics Specialist, Embedded Systems Engineer, Enterprise Network Architect, IT Consultant, Network Engineer, Network Security Specialist, Penetration Tester, Systems Analyst, Technical Support Specialist, Telecommunications Engineer, Wireless Communication Engineer.

Entry Requirement

General Requirements:

1. All students are required to sit for the Malaysian University English Test (MUET) and meet the required MUET band score for their respective programmes, as indicated at the bottom of this page, in order to graduate.

2. Students with IGCSE/O-Level or other equivalent qualifications who did not sit for SPM, must obtain at least Grade C in Bahasa Melayu and pass History in SPM in order to graduate.

SPM / O-Level / Equivalent Subject Requirements:

Obtain at least Grade B in THREE (3) of the following subjects: 
  • Mathematics
  • Additional Mathematics
  • Any ONE (1) subjects: Physics / Chemistry / Biology / Computer Science / Information and Communication Technology (ICT)
STPM
  • Malaysian citizen
  • Obtain a minimum CGPA of 3.00 in Science stream and;
  • Obtain a minimum of grade B- in Additional Mathematics and Grade B- in any of the following subjects:
    • Physics
    • Information and Communication Technology
    • Chemistry
    • Biology
Matriculation / Foundation

    • Physics
    • Fundamentals of Information and Communication Technology
    • Chemistry
    • Biology
    • Computer Science
    • IT
    • Programming
    • Computing
